Generate a complete fake dataset

Source: R/faker.R
fkr.Rd

A dataset-level abstraction over the individual fkr_*() generators: describe each column with a specs list and get back a single, ready-to-use data.frame with n rows.

Usage

fkr(n, specs)

Arguments

n

Number of rows to generate. A single non-negative whole number.

specs

A named list describing each column. Names become column names and must be unique and non-empty. Each element can be:

  • A function of n – the common case – called as spec(n). This covers every fkr_*() generator directly, including ones with extra optional arguments (their defaults just apply), and function(n) fkr_city(n, province = "Cebu") to fix extra arguments.

  • A function with a data argument – for a column that depends on columns generated earlier in specs – called as spec(n, data = data), where data is the partial result built so far (a data.frame with one column per already-processed spec, in specs order). The argument must be named exactly data for this to trigger; its position doesn't matter.

  • An already-generated vector or data.frame with length/nrow equal to n.

  • A single scalar, recycled to length n (e.g. a constant column like country = "Philippines").

When a spec (whether a function's result or a literal value) is a data.frame – e.g. fkr_address() or fkr_coordinates() – its columns are flattened into the output, prefixed with the spec's own name (address becomes address_street, address_city, ...).

Value

A data.frame with n rows and one column per (flattened) spec, in the order given in specs.

Age/birthday consistency

If fkr_age() and either fkr_birthday() or fkr_birthday_split() both appear unwrapped (i.e. passed as the bare function, not e.g. function(n) fkr_age(n, age_range = 18:65)) among specs, fkr() draws the age once and feeds it to the birthday spec(s), so the generated age and the age implied by the birthdate always agree – instead of each independently drawing its own random age. Wrap either in an anonymous function (even a trivial function(n) fkr_age(n)) to opt out and get independent draws.

Examples

fkr_seed(1)
fkr(5, list(
  first_name = fkr_first_name,
  last_name = fkr_last_name,
  sex = fkr_sex,
  age = fkr_age,
  date_of_birth = fkr_birthday,
  address = fkr_address,
  coordinates = fkr_coordinates
))
#>   first_name last_name    sex age date_of_birth       address_street
#> 1    Raymond Dela Cruz   Male   6    2020-04-05 422 Magsaysay Avenue
#> 2    Lazarus    Cortez   Male   9    2017-08-09        111 Luna Road
#> 3     Joseph Dela Cruz   Male  16    2010-10-20 404 Aguinaldo Avenue
#> 4      Quinn    Javier   Male  47    1979-01-20 924 Magsaysay Avenue
#> 5     Tamara    Garcia Female   4    2022-08-08     532 Luna Highway
#>   address_barangay         address_city  address_province
#> 1          Malinta               Bontoc Mountain Province
#> 2         Tagumpay        Batangas City          Batangas
#> 3       Santa Rosa          Iligan City   Lanao del Norte
#> 4             Looc           Nabunturan      Davao de Oro
#> 5        Poblacion Puerto Princesa City           Palawan
#>                           address_region address_zip coordinates_latitude
#> 1 Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR)        2616             9.272849
#> 2               Region IV-A (CALABARZON)        4200            11.268917
#> 3           Region X (Northern Mindanao)        9200            17.090777
#> 4               Region XI (Davao Region)        8800            16.700753
#> 5                        MIMAROPA Region        5300            10.059854
#>   coordinates_longitude
#> 1              124.4400
#> 2              126.2180
#> 3              121.1162
#> 4              123.8114
#> 5              120.7799

# A column that depends on one generated earlier in `specs`:
fkr(5, list(
  age = fkr_age,
  civil_status = function(n, data) {
    ifelse(data$age < 18, "Single", fkr_civil_status(n))
  }
))
#>   age civil_status
#> 1   7       Single
#> 2  28       Single
#> 3   4       Single
#> 4  24       Single
#> 5   2       Single
